name: handoff
description: Automatic handoff notes: prepares next-phase-auto.md before compaction and at session end, warns when context is nearly full, and provides /handoff

auto_handoff._doc: Auto-Handoff (lossless handoff across sessions). PreCompact writes a six-block stub to _staging right before compaction (the safety net; does not depend on token measurement); PostCompact fills the compaction summary into it; after compaction, PostToolBatch injects a prompt asking the model to complete the subjective blocks. The token_warn keys are the Stop-time context-usage warning. enabled=false turns everything off. Token measurement reads the real token counts from the transcript's message.usage; context_window_tokens is the default / floor of the denominator (1M, matching the usual 1M Opus), and the actual window calibrates itself: once usage has gone past 200k the window must be 1M (the harness compacts before a 200k window fills up, so 200k is never reached). context_base_overhead_tokens is only used by the character-count fallback (when there is no usage). The core's DeferralGate and EVASION_CONTEXT_EXEMPT also read context_window_tokens / context_base_overhead_tokens from this section, with the same literal defaults when the plugin is off.
